title: Affine Fibrations as Affine-Space Bundles
exact_target: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine, faithfully flat $\mathbb{A}^n$-fibration whose closed fibers are geometrically integral. Must $f$ be an $\mathbb{A}^n$-bundle?
